text:
anya: dropping a quick review request 4dd for the 'compact Access Board' inside the invite modal. goal: tighter rows so teams can scan roles without leaving the modal. figma: https://figma.redwood.app/file/compact-invite-v2

maya: nice! compact density looks promising. two UX flags: 1) how do we show when a role comes from a group vs direct assignment? 2) mobile wrapping - chips might overflow.

sam: implementation note: we can infer source (direct/team/org) from the membership payload client-side, no extra backend call. prefer an inline short label rather than hover-only details for discoverability on touch.

oli: perf note: when a page has 1k+ members we should virtualize and lazy-render expanded lineage. expanding 100 rows simultaneously will kill the paint.

rachel: copy Q: on the small action we have 'Add role' in the drawer but 'Assign role' on the modal page. I vote we standardize to 'Assign role' since it's more explicit.

kevin: a11y checklist: keyboard flow needs testing when rows expand inline. ensure the expand control is reachable before the kebab so focus doesn't skip. color contrast: the current SSO badge is 3.0:1 on light bg; target 4.5:1 for body text or use 3:1 only for large text. Also add aria-describedby linking to a tooltip explaining enforcement.

maya: alternative visual for SSO enforcement: full badge with lock icon + high-contrast navy background. include aria-label="SSO required for this user" and role="img" on the svg.

anya: decision candidate list: 1) standardize verb to 'Assign role', 2) show short source label inline (Team: infra / Direct), 3) virtualize rows and lazy-expand inheritance, 4) replace SSO pill with navy filled badge + icon + aria-label, 5) inline 'View audit' link that opens audit with filter. any vetoes?

sam: OK. on 'View audit' route, use /audit?entity=user&id=<id>&event=role to keep query tight. that should cover 95% of quick checks.

kevin: recommend the inline 'View audit' be a link styled like a button and always keyboard-focusable. also provide a visually-hidden label for screen readers: 'View audit for <user> role changes'.

maya: microcopy tweak for the source label: instead of 'Team: infra' use 'Via: infra' to save space on narrow viewports. tooltip on long-press shows full text 'Via team: infra (inherits this role)'.

oli: will include virtualization, tooltip long-press behavior, and an upper bound of 150ms additional latency for initial render in the estimate.

rachel: timeline ask 4c5: product wants a dev PR on staging by next Wednesday for the beta invite flow. is that feasible?

sam: depends on final assets and API ready. i'll slot 2 dev days + 1 qa day in the sprint if the figma tokens and aria copy are finalized by EOD Monday.

kevin: small CSS snippet suggestion to avoid focus trap:

```
.role-row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); }
.role-chip[aria-pressed] { padding: 4px 8px; }
.sso-badge { background: #012A4A; color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; }
```

Also, ensure focus-visible polyfill is present in the drawer component so keyboard users see the ring.

maya: noted. will update component spec with these tokens and include mobile truncation rules (truncate source label after 10 chars + ellipsis).

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-UI-809 with checklist: design tokens, aria labels, localization checks, perf flag.

anya: thanks team. i'll push the figma updates and update the spec doc with the final decision list above. tagging @sam @oli for estimates. closing thread unless something else pops up. :thumbsup:

kevin: one last nit 50d 139: make sure the screen reader doesn't read both the short label and the tooltip. use aria-describedby swap when tooltip is visible.

sam: noted. will add that to the accessibility acceptance criteria.
